assurance: REAL_LOCAL_SQLITE_ZSTD_ARTIFACT_AND_TRUSTED_LIBRARY; synthetic task/reviewer/human fixtures; no OS/provider qualification

tests.name: M161-GATE-FORGERY: caller status and a model PASS artifact never certify an unexecuted gate
M161-GATE-ADMISSION-INTEGRITY: engine validates admitted Task, frozen rules and actual Artifact bytes
M161-GATE-CHECKER: trusted checker runs actual bounded reads and engine captures code provenance
M161-GATE-STATUS: FAIL, NOT_RUN, BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE and SIMULATED remain distinct
M161-GATE-MOCK: simulated checkers and profiles cannot become real PASS
M161-GATE-MISSING: missing design, delivery and unknown checker are NOT_RUN
M161-GATE-INDEPENDENCE: G4 requires registered independent reviewer and exact candidate/author binding
M161-GATE-HUMAN: actual trusted approval record is required and bound to candidate/rules/profile
M161-GATE-OFF: OFF records BYPASSED, does not execute checker, and cannot authorize protected capability
M161-GATE-OFF-RACE: gate disabled while actual artifact stream awaits commits BYPASSED
M161-GATE-EPOCH-RACE: unrelated control change during validation becomes INCONCLUSIVE
M161-GATE-RULE-BINDING: changed Task binding is blocked while new registry alone preserves frozen Task
M161-GATE-FINAL: seven actual gates share candidate/baseline/profile/rules and old evidence cannot pass a new candidate
M161-GATE-CORRUPT: actual corrupted Artifact freezes owner and leaves no PASS or protected authorization
M161-GATE-LIMITS: evidence, duplicate kinds and concurrent gate execution are bounded
M161-RULES-TEXT: source text remains verbatim and never becomes an executable natural-language rule
M161-RULES-DSL: all five classes, finite constraints, dependencies, scope and enforcement bindings are explicit
M161-RULES-UNKNOWN: unknown constraint, class, fields, feature and policy are rejected
M161-RULES-DEPENDENCIES: duplicates, unknown dependencies, cycles and narrowing dependencies fail closed
M161-RULES-NO-PROMPT-PEP: natural language cannot claim machine enforcement or a forged owner
M161-RULES-VERSIONS: new tasks capture the new version while existing task bindings remain frozen
M161-RULES-MIGRATION: migration requires explicit trusted authorization and persists separately from Task state
M161-RULES-LIMITS: source count, source bytes, duplicate source and rule count are strictly bounded
M161-RULES-CLOSE-FENCE: compiler OFF during streamed source validation prevents publishing a registry
M161-RULES-REOPEN: immutable registry and task binding survive actual SQLite close/reopen
